receipt.checks: ZIP CRC; all file hashes; frozen metadata/sample IDs; targets; paired seeds; config snapshots/shards; prediction/weight identities; trace aggregates; ddof=1 means/std/n; cohorts
receipt.limits: No delivered code executed, GPU recomputation, or proof of generation-time provenance. Noise maps are not archived.

protocol.nominal: equal-cell Type III mixed ANOVA; subject nested in dataset; effect-specific subject-within-dataset error; pooled GG epsilon
protocol.robust: heteroscedastic WTS with independent group Gaussian parametric bootstrap; each bootstrap covariance re-estimated using normal/Wishart sufficient statistics; plus-one correction; no pseudoinverse or jitter to conceal singularities
protocol.primary_inference: report nominal ANOVA and heteroscedastic WTS together; 14 quality tests per cohort; recorded log1p(ms) separate exploratory 7-test family; Holm separately for each procedure
protocol.contrast: dataset=ImageNet minus VOC; within main effects average datasets EQUALLY, regardless of n; dataset interactions difference of corresponding within contrasts
protocol.uncertainty: independent image bootstrap in each dataset, paired over models/methods/metrics; class-stratified and IID-image percentile marginal CIs; singleton-class and fixed-checkpoint limitations retained
protocol.assumptions: independent original-image vectors, finite fourth moments and positive definite group contrast covariance for WTS; bootstrap is asymptotic, not an exact finite-sample test; nominal ANOVA additionally uses pooled covariance and GG approximation
protocol.scope: all 7 factorial terms computed for nominal raw task scores, not causal dataset effects or a common quality scale. Softmax/sigmoid, class space, image population, preprocessing and shared two-round timing confounds remain. Teacher/A/C/E acceptance and final freeze are separate.
